BG4 EP (PSS) CLOSED CIRCUIT SELF CONTAINE D BREATHING APPRATUS APPROVED BY DGMS USED IN IRRESPIRABLE ATMOSPHERE FOR RESC 1 011490251 UE AND MINES RECOVERY WORK, MAKE- DRAG Number 12 ER, GERMANY, WEIGHT OF CHARGED OXYGEN C YLINGER 14.8KG (LXWXH) 595X450X185 mm Annexure-I (Technical Specifications & Working Principle) TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS • Manufacturer: Dräger (Germany) • Breathing Circuit: Closed-circuit • Operating Pressure: Positive pressure • Weight: ~15.4 kg • Breathing Air Cooler: Present • Constant O₂ Flow: 1.5–1.9 L/min • Demand Flow: >80 L/min • By-pass Flow: >50 L/min • Breathing Bag Capacity: 5.5 litres • Demand Valve Opening Pressure: +0.1 to +2.5 mbar • Relief Valve Opening Pressure: +4 to +7 mbar • Rated Duration: 4 hours • Oxygen Cylinder: 2 L × 200 bar (400 L) • Dimensions: 590 × 450 × 185 mm • Saliva/Moisture Control: Drain valve • Additional Feature: Electronic monitoring system DESCRIPTION & WORKING PRINCIPLE The Dräger PSS BG-4 Plus is a compressed-oxygen, closed-circuit breathing apparatus designed fo r long-duration rescue operations in toxic or oxygen-deficient environments. Exhaled air passes th rough a CO₂ absorbent canister containing soda lime, where carbon dioxide is removed. The purifi ed breathing gas is stored in a spring-loaded breathing bag. During inhalation, air flows from the b reathing bag through a heat-absorbent canister, which reduces breathing gas temperature, impro ving user comfort. Oxygen is supplied through a constant-flow system and a volume-activated de mand valve. A bypass valve is provided for emergency oxygen supply. The apparatus operates un der positive pressure, preventing ingress of hazardous gases. An electronic monitoring system pro vides continuous status indication and alarms. Important Note: (1) Only Payment term 30 days’ credit after receipt & acceptance of material will be accepted. (2) Delivery Period: Immediately but within six (06) months from the date of receipt of PO. (3) Inspection of materials at our stores will be final. (4) Offer must be submitted FOR destination, delivery of materials at our Mines Stores, Mosaba ni basis. Supplier shall arrange transporter and deliver materials as freight paid basis. (5) Acceptance of all terms & conditions of the enquiry in the form of your declaration with seal and signature in each page of the ATC. Alternatively, Bidder can submit their declaration in L etter head that they accept all terms & Conditions of ATC. in their letter head shall be summarily rejected. (8) Please provide the GST % of the offered material.
